• First 24-Hour Cooling Period Security Restriction: • Whenever a customer links a new bank account or resets their UPI PIN, NPCI security protocols enforce a strict cooling period.
• Outward UPI payments are restricted to a maximum cumulative limit of Rs 5,000 for the initial 24 hours following the PIN reset.
• Full Rs 1,00,000 daily limit automatically unlocks exactly 24 hours after PIN registration.

 • Mandatory Auto-Reversal TAT: Under RBI and NPCI Harmonization of TAT guidelines, failed transactions must be automatically

• Delayed Reversal Compensation: • If the reversal takes longer than T+2 business days, FinBase compensates the customer Rs 100 per calendar day of delay.

without requiring any manual claim submission.
